title: PII stored without encryption at rest
description: Shipping addresses (PII) are stored in the orders table as plain JSON without field-level encryption.
label: true_positive
label_reason: Order.shipping_address is a JSON column with no encryption

title: User SSN stored in database
description: The User model contains an SSN column which is highly sensitive PII.
label: true_positive
label_reason: SSN column in User model with no apparent need

title: No data retention policy for audit logs
description: Audit logs contain user IDs and IP addresses but have no expiration or deletion mechanism.
label: true_positive
label_reason: No TTL or cleanup mechanism for audit_logs table

title: Product images may contain EXIF metadata with location data
description: Uploaded product images may retain GPS coordinates in EXIF metadata.
label: false_positive
label_reason: Product images are uploaded by merchants, not users — speculative without evidence of EXIF retention

title: Missing consent mechanism for data collection
description: User registration collects email, name, phone, and SSN without documented consent flow.
label: true_positive
label_reason: No consent endpoint or checkbox flow in the registration code

title: No data export/deletion endpoint (right to erasure)
description: No API endpoint exists for users to request export or deletion of their personal data.
label: true_positive
label_reason: GDPR Art 17 requires right to erasure; no such endpoint exists
